lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to buy a linen loincloth and wear it, and Jeremiah does so.
The LORD tells Jeremiah to hide the loincloth in a crevice of the rocks at Jordan, and he does.
Many days later, Jeremiah digs up the loincloth at Perath, and it is ruined and of no use at all.
The LORD says He will ruin the pride of Judah and Jerusalem, who refuse to listen and worship other gods.
The LORD says He will fill the people with drunkenness, but He will spare the kings and priests.

wrong_details.wrong: He will spare the kings and priests
wrong_details.true: He will fill the kings, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem with drunkenness
